question: Which organization relaunched the SPREE scheme in 2025?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**ESIC**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• ESIC approves amnesty and registration scheme for its beneficiaries.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
In its **196th meeting**, the **Employees’ State Insurance Corporation (ESIC)** re-launched **SPREE** for **2025**.

 
 
• 
 
**SPREE** stands for **Scheme to Promote Registration of Employers/Employees**.

 
 
• 
 
Originally launched in **2016**, its aim is to bring **unregistered employers** and **left-out workers** (including **contractual and temporary staff**) under the **ESI Act**.

 
 
• 
 
The **renewed SPREE scheme** will be open from **July 1 to December 31, 2025**.

 
 
• 
 
The approach is based on **voluntary compliance**, not penalization, to:

 
 
• 
 
**Reduce litigation**

 
 
• 
 
**Encourage formal registration**

 
 
• 
 
**Foster goodwill and engagement**

 
 
 
 
• 
 
ESIC also approved the **Amnesty Scheme – 2025**, a **one-time dispute resolution window**.

 
 
• 
 
The **Amnesty Scheme** will run from **October 1, 2025 to September 30, 2026**, promoting **compliance and reducing legal disputes** under the **ESI Act**.
